name: sniperstack
description: Find winning products, add them to your SniperStack store and launch COD landing pages.

interface.shortDescription: Find winning products and launch COD landing pages.
interface.longDescription: SniperStack helps cash-on-delivery sellers find products that sell and launch them fast. Browse the Marketplace Radar for the best sellers on AliExpress, 1688, Alibaba, Wildberries and Temu, add a product to your store from a supplier link or from its details and photos, and create an AI-written landing page for it — all from a chat.
defaultPrompt: Use SniperStack to show me this week's best sellers on 1688 and pick three I could sell.
Use SniperStack to import this product link into my store and make a landing page for it.
Use SniperStack to list my products that are ready for a landing page.
